prelude: Clara breeds Pelra goats. Whether a goat has velvet ears is controlled by one gene with a dominant allele A and a recessive allele a. The trait is dominant: AA and Aa animals show it; aa animals do not. The goat Mitha (the sire) and the goat Linka (the dam) have a litter.  In this breed each of an animal's two gene copies is a with probability 0.65, independently. Each parent passes one of its two copies to each kid, each copy with probability 1/2, independently for every kid. A carrier test on Mitha reports correctly whether it is Aa with probability 0.86.
